operations.name: Abort Copy File
operations.notes: Copies complete synchronously, so every valid request returns 409 NoPendingCopyOperation after the destination and lease checks.

operations.name: Copy File
operations.notes: Same-instance sources, including a share snapshot source in the destination's account; the copy completes synchronously with x-ms-copy-status success and shares the source's extents. The host-style name {account}.file.* of a configured account is treated as local. Blob and external sources return NotImplemented. A file in another account configured on this instance needs a read SAS of that account (ADR-0037): the destination's Shared Key, a SAS signed with another key, no SAS, or an unconfigured account is 403 CannotVerifyCopySource, and a share snapshot of it is 400 SnapshotAcrossSharesNotSupported. These codes are unverified until F-29 is recorded. A SAS on the source URL must allow reading that file (signature, expiry, resource, stored policy, read permission) or the copy is 403 CannotVerifyCopySource; a source URL without a SAS is read with the request's own credentials. The status for a bad source SAS is unverified (ADR-0032). NFS: NFS shares: x-ms-file-mode-copy-mode and x-ms-file-owner-copy-mode (source by default, an unverified default); a symbolic link as source or destination is 400 XNfs4FileTypeUnsupportedException (unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Create Directory
operations.notes: Case-insensitive, case-preserving names with Azure's name, depth and length rules. File attributes, timestamps (now, preserve or ISO), permission, permission key and metadata are stored and returned with x-ms-file-id and x-ms-file-parent-id. From 2025-01-05 x-ms-file-permission-format: binary converts x-ms-file-permission from a base64 binary descriptor (ADR-0032, unverified against Azure). NFS: On an NFS share: x-ms-mode (default 0755), x-ms-owner and x-ms-group (default 0); the response carries them and x-ms-file-file-type: Directory instead of the SMB attribute and permission headers. SMB-only request headers are ignored there. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Create File
operations.notes: Requires x-ms-type: file and x-ms-content-length (up to 4 TiB); replaces an existing file as Azure does, honoring its lease and read-only attribute. Content type, encoding, language, disposition, cache control, content MD5, metadata and SMB properties are stored. Content is sparse and allocates no bytes. From 2025-01-05 x-ms-file-permission-format: binary converts x-ms-file-permission from a base64 binary descriptor (ADR-0032, unverified against Azure). NFS: NFS shares: x-ms-mode (default 0644), x-ms-owner, x-ms-group, and x-ms-file-file-type which must be Regular. Replacing a symbolic link is 400 XNfs4FileTypeUnsupportedException (unverified); replacing a hard-linked name rewrites the shared inode. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Create Hard Link
operations.notes: PUT ?restype=hardlink with x-ms-type: file and x-ms-file-target-file (a path from the share root or a URL of this share). The link is another name for the same inode: content, properties and file id are shared and x-ms-link-count rises. Needs an NFS share and x-ms-version 2025-05-05 or later (below that, 400 InvalidQueryParameterValue); a directory target is 400 InvalidHeaderValue and a symbolic-link target 400 XNfs4FileTypeUnsupportedException; ParentNotFound, ResourceNotFound and ResourceAlreadyExists as documented; a share snapshot is 400 InvalidQueryParameterValue. Owner only (Shared Key or a bearer token), as Azure documents. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Create Permission
operations.notes: Stores an SDDL string per share and returns a stable key for it. SDDL is checked only for an owner and DACL shape; it is never evaluated. From 2024-11-04 the body's format may be binary, a base64 self-relative descriptor converted to the stored SDDL (the same descriptor in either form shares one key); below that version format is ignored. SACLs and entries SDDL cannot carry are refused with 400 FileInvalidPermission or CannotConvertToSddlDueToCustomAce (ADR-0032, unverified against Azure). NFS: SMB-only: answers 403 XNfs4ShareDeniedException on an NFS share (ADR-0029; the status and code for this case are unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Create Share
operations.notes: Quota (1 to 102400 GiB), access tier (TransactionOptimized, Hot, Cool) and metadata are stored and returned. Provisioned IOPS and bandwidth are not modeled. NFS: x-ms-enabled-protocols SMB or NFS (NFS accepted on any account, where Azure needs a premium one), x-ms-root-squash and x-ms-enable-snapshot-virtual-directory-access on NFS shares only (stored, never enforced). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Create Symbolic Link
operations.notes: PUT ?restype=symboliclink with x-ms-link-text kept as sent (at most 4096 bytes, never resolved), x-ms-owner, x-ms-group, metadata and timestamps; mode 0777 (unverified). Needs an NFS share and x-ms-version 2025-07-05 or later. ParentNotFound and ResourceAlreadyExists as documented. Owner only (Shared Key or a bearer token), as Azure documents. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Delete Directory
operations.notes: Returns DirectoryNotEmpty (409) for a non-empty directory; the share root cannot be deleted.

operations.name: Delete File
operations.notes: Requires the lease ID when leased and refuses read-only files with ReadOnlyAttribute. Extents are reclaimed once no file or snapshot references them. NFS: NFS shares: returns x-ms-link-count, the count after the delete; the last name frees the content, and deleting the first of several names keeps the inode under another. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Delete Share
operations.notes: Honors x-ms-delete-snapshots (include, include-leased), ShareHasSnapshots and DeleteShareWhenSnapshotLeased, and deletes a single snapshot with sharesnapshot. Deletion is immediate unless the operator sets --share-retention-days above zero; then a deleted share is kept, restorable, for that many days on the injected clock.

operations.name: Force Close Handles
operations.notes: Requires x-ms-handle-id and reports zero handles closed and zero failed. NFS: SMB-only: answers 403 XNfs4ShareDeniedException on an NFS share (ADR-0029; the status and code for this case are unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Get Directory Metadata
operations.notes: Returns the directory's metadata and SMB headers. NFS: NFS shares: POSIX headers instead of SMB attributes. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Get Directory Properties
operations.notes: Works on the share root and on share snapshots. A file at the path returns ResourceTypeMismatch. NFS: NFS shares: POSIX headers instead of SMB attributes. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Get File
operations.notes: Full and ranged reads (x-ms-range or Range), x-ms-range-get-content-md5 for ranges up to 4 MiB, holes read as zeros, SAS response-header overrides, share snapshots. A range starting at or after the end returns InvalidRange. Standard If-Match, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since and If-Unmodified-Since are evaluated although Azure does not document them for Files. NFS: NFS shares: POSIX headers and x-ms-link-count. A symbolic link is 400 XNfs4FileTypeUnsupportedException (unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Get File Metadata
operations.notes: Returns the file's metadata. NFS: NFS shares: POSIX headers and x-ms-link-count. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Get File Properties
operations.notes: HEAD with the file's size, HTTP properties, SMB properties, lease state, copy properties and metadata. NFS: NFS shares: POSIX headers, x-ms-file-file-type (Regular or SymLink; Azure's pages disagree on the casing) and x-ms-link-count. Works on a symbolic link. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Get File Service Properties
operations.notes: Returns the stored HourMetrics, MinuteMetrics, CORS rules and SMB multichannel setting, with Azure's defaults for a new account. Metrics are never collected, CORS rules are stored but not applied to requests, and multichannel has no effect.

operations.name: Get Permission
operations.notes: Returns the stored SDDL for a key. From 2024-11-04 the answer carries format, and x-ms-file-permission-format: binary returns the base64 binary descriptor converted from the stored SDDL; before that version only permission is returned. Descriptors with a SACL or an entry SDDL cannot carry do not convert (ADR-0032, unverified against Azure). NFS: SMB-only: answers 403 XNfs4ShareDeniedException on an NFS share (ADR-0029; the status and code for this case are unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Get Share ACL
operations.notes: Returns up to five stored access policies. NFS: SMB-only: answers 403 XNfs4ShareDeniedException on an NFS share (ADR-0029; the status and code for this case are unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Get Share Metadata
operations.notes: Returns the same headers as Get Share Properties. NFS: Same headers as Get Share Properties, including the NFS ones. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Get Share Properties
operations.notes: Returns quota, access tier, metadata, enabled protocols and lease headers; honors sharesnapshot. Conditional headers are not evaluated. NFS: Reports x-ms-enabled-protocols, and for an NFS share x-ms-root-squash and x-ms-enable-snapshot-virtual-directory-access (not on snapshots). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Get Share Stats
operations.notes: ShareUsageBytes is the allocated (written) bytes of the live share, so sparse files and cleared ranges do not count. Snapshots are not included.

operations.name: Lease File
operations.notes: Acquire (infinite only), change, release and break (immediate) with the Available, Leased and Broken states; renew is rejected. Writes, deletes, copies onto the file and renames require the lease ID, and a broken lease clears on the next unleased write. Files in share snapshots cannot be leased. NFS: SMB-only: answers 403 XNfs4ShareDeniedException on an NFS share (ADR-0029; the status and code for this case are unverified). File leases do not exist on NFS shares. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Lease Share
operations.notes: Acquire, renew, change, release and break with fixed (15 to 60 s) or infinite durations on shares and share snapshots. State is computed lazily from the clock and survives restart. Lease-use mismatches return 412 with the FileShare operation codes from the error list rather than the 409 shown in the outcome table.

operations.name: List Directories and Files
operations.notes: Single-level listing of files and directories sorted by upper-cased name, with prefix, marker, maxresults and include=Timestamps,ETag,Attributes,PermissionKey. Names containing U+FFFE or U+FFFF are not percent-encoded. NFS: NFS shares list only FileId, Name and a file's Content-Length (symbolic links as files, hard links under every name with the inode's id); include is ignored. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: List Handles
operations.notes: Always returns an empty Entries list for existing directories and files because there is no SMB session to hold handles. NFS: SMB-only: answers 403 XNfs4ShareDeniedException on an NFS share (ADR-0029; the status and code for this case are unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: List Ranges
operations.notes: Allocated ranges with adjacent ranges merged, an optional x-ms-range window, and prevsharesnapshot diffs reporting Range and ClearRange. Diffs return PreviousSnapshotNotFound, PreviousSnapshotCannotBeNewer and FileGenerationMismatch. A rewrite with identical bytes still counts as changed. NFS: NFS shares: a symbolic link is 400 XNfs4FileTypeUnsupportedException (unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: List Shares
operations.notes: Supports prefix, marker, maxresults, include=metadata and include=snapshots; markers are opaque local tokens. include=deleted adds soft-deleted shares, when --share-retention-days is above zero (otherwise there are none to add), with Deleted, Version, DeletedTime and RemainingRetentionDays. NFS: Adds RootSquash and EnableSnapshotVirtualDirectoryAccess for NFS shares. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Put Range
operations.notes: x-ms-write update (1 byte to 4 MiB) writes a new immutable extent made durable before the metadata commits; clear deallocates the range without writing zeros. Content-MD5 and x-ms-content-crc64 are verified. A range beyond the file length returns InvalidRange. Share quota is enforced on allocated bytes and in-memory mode fails with 507 at the memory limit. NFS: NFS shares: a symbolic link is 400 XNfs4FileTypeUnsupportedException (unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Put Range From URL
operations.notes: Same-instance sources: the destination's account, or another configured account with a read SAS of that account (ADR-0037), which is what AzCopy's file-to-file copy needs. x-ms-source-content-crc64 is compared with the bytes read before the range is published (400 Crc64Mismatch, nothing written); x-ms-source-if-match-crc64 and x-ms-source-if-none-match-crc64 answer 412 ConditionNotMet when unmet; the response carries x-ms-content-crc64. Azure defines no source MD5 or x-ms-source-if-* header for Files, so none is checked. The 412 code is unverified until F-28 is recorded. Like Copy File, a SAS on the source URL must allow reading that file or Azuifer returns 403 CannotVerifyCopySource (ADR-0032). Source-SAS errors and newer copy diagnostics are pending live recording (F-24 and F-25). On NFS shares a symbolic link as source or destination returns 400 XNfs4FileTypeUnsupportedException locally; NFS behavior is not recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Read Symbolic Link
operations.notes: GET ?restype=symboliclink returns x-ms-link-text, on a live share or a snapshot. A node that is not a symbolic link is 400 XNfs4FileTypeUnsupportedException (unverified). Needs an NFS share and x-ms-version 2025-07-05 or later. Owner only (Shared Key or a bearer token), as Azure documents. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Rename Directory
operations.notes: One row update moves the whole subtree. The source is a same-share URL; other shares or accounts return RenameAcrossAccountsAndSharesNotSupported, a destination inside the source returns RenameCycle, and an existing destination returns ResourceAlreadyExists. Open-file conflicts do not occur because handles are not modeled. NFS: SMB-only: answers 403 XNfs4ShareDeniedException on an NFS share (ADR-0029; the status and code for this case are unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Rename File
operations.notes: Honors x-ms-file-rename-replace-if-exists, -ignore-readonly, source and destination lease IDs, content type, metadata and SMB property overrides. Cross-share renames and share snapshots are rejected. NFS: SMB-only: answers 403 XNfs4ShareDeniedException on an NFS share (ADR-0029; the status and code for this case are unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Restore Share
operations.notes: PUT /{share}?restype=share&comp=undelete with x-ms-deleted-share-name and x-ms-deleted-share-version restores a soft-deleted share, with its snapshots, under the name in the path, which must be free (409 ShareAlreadyExists); an unknown name or version is 404 ShareNotFound. Soft delete is off unless the operator sets --share-retention-days (Azure keeps this setting in the management plane), and the version is the deletion time in milliseconds rather than Azure's opaque string.

operations.name: Set Directory Metadata
operations.notes: Replaces all metadata.

operations.name: Set Directory Properties
operations.notes: Updates attributes, timestamps and permission; absent headers preserve current values. From 2025-01-05 x-ms-file-permission-format: binary converts x-ms-file-permission from a base64 binary descriptor (ADR-0032, unverified against Azure). NFS: NFS shares: x-ms-mode, x-ms-owner and x-ms-group; an omitted one keeps its value. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Set File Metadata
operations.notes: Replaces all metadata; requires the lease ID when leased.

operations.name: Set File Properties
operations.notes: Resizes with x-ms-content-length and updates SMB properties. HTTP properties are replaced as a set only when at least one x-ms-content-* or cache-control header is sent; otherwise they are preserved, so a pure resize keeps the content type. From 2025-01-05 x-ms-file-permission-format: binary converts x-ms-file-permission from a base64 binary descriptor (ADR-0032, unverified against Azure). NFS: NFS shares: x-ms-mode, x-ms-owner, x-ms-group and x-ms-link-count in the response; resizing a symbolic link is 400 XNfs4FileTypeUnsupportedException (unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Set File Service Properties
operations.notes: Validates and stores metrics, at most five CORS rules and the SMB multichannel flag; sections left out of the body keep their stored values. Answers 202. Nothing stored is acted on.

operations.name: Set Share ACL
operations.notes: Validates the SignedIdentifiers document (five policies, unique IDs of 64 characters or fewer, rcwdl permissions, ISO times). Policies are honored by service SAS tokens that name them with si. NFS: SMB-only: answers 403 XNfs4ShareDeniedException on an NFS share (ADR-0029; the status and code for this case are unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Set Share Metadata
operations.notes: Replaces all metadata; requires the lease ID when leased.

operations.name: Set Share Properties
operations.notes: Updates quota and access tier; requires the lease ID when the share is leased. Azure's quota-downgrade and tier-transition limits are not enforced. NFS: x-ms-root-squash and x-ms-enable-snapshot-virtual-directory-access on NFS shares; on an SMB share they are 400 InvalidHeaderValue (unverified). Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).

operations.name: Snapshot Share
operations.notes: Copies the share's rows and shares file content by extent reference. The 200-snapshot limit is not enforced. Snapshot IDs are millisecond timestamps rendered with seven fractional digits. NFS: An NFS share's snapshot keeps its hard links and symbolic links. Nothing about the NFS behavior is recorded from Azure (ADR-0029).
